treeFire.note: a blazing tree canopy: a heap of flame tongues, embers and dark smoke rising (84 x 152). Loop it over a burning tree; anchor = the middle of the blaze, so put it on the canopy centre (about the tree's anchor minus 0.55 of its height in y); scale ~0.6 for young trees. When it burns out, switch the tree to its state 0 (oldTree / oldFir: a charred snag with embers)
